name: walk 127,836 studs for a burger 🍔
desc:
🍔 you're starving, and left with no other option but to walk 127,836 studs for the nearest snack... what will you encounter on your pointless journey? 

📖 each stud milestone multiplies your speed, and you can increase your base speed by rebirthing and gaining completions!

⭐ LIKE + FAVORITE for updates and new burgers!!

💡 inspired by walk 50000 studs for nothing
